subject: Post-call security recap: SOC2 / pen test & vulnerability process next steps
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@meditech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call security recap: SOC2 / pen test & vulnerability process next steps

Hi Carmen —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on security artifacts you'll need from us and what we'd like to see from Meditech to move to the next stage of evaluation.

Call recap (high level):
- Meditech is evaluating Redwood for a HIPAA-adjacent patient data pipeline (PHI-in-scope for analytics).
- Primary questions from your security team centered on SOC 2 status, recent penetration testing, vulnerability management SLAs, and vendor questionnaire answers.
- You asked for a clear path to obtain our SOC 2 evidence, pen test reports under NDA, and our recommended scanning cadence.

Requests from our side (what would unblock a technical review):
1) SOC 2: current status (Type I/II) and last audit date; whether report can be shared under NDA.
2) Pen test: most recent external pen test summary/report and whether a full report is sharable under NDA.
3) Vulnerability management: cadence for external/internal scans, time-to-remediate SLAs by severity (e.g., critical/urgent/medium), and whether you run authenticated scans in pre-prod.
4) Vendor security questionnaire: I attached a short Redwood security checklist to speed triage — can you send your completed vendor questionnaire or a preferred intake doc?

Proposed timeline / next steps:
- Please share whatever you can this week (redacted summaries are fine initially).
- If full pen reports require an NDA, happy to sign — I can route to Legal and get a standard mutual NDA within 24 hours.
- Suggest a 30-minute follow-up with your security lead and mine the week of Dec 6 to go over any blockers.

Attachments: redwood-security-checklist.pdf (brief checklist for intake).

If helpful I can also outline the vulnerability disclosure and remediation expectations we typically ask of partners (SLAs and exposure windows).

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@meditech.com>

Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 13:02:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call security recap: SOC2 / pen test & vulnerability process next steps

Alex —

Great recap and thanks for the checklist. Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: Meditech completed a SOC 2 Type II in June 2025. We retain the full report but we only provide it under NDA; it is currently stored with our legal team.
- Pen test: last full external pen test was June 2026 (third-party firm). We cannot publish the full internal findings publicly; however I attached a redacted external pen test summary that should help for initial triage.
- Vulnerability mgmt & cadence: monthly external scans, authenticated scans quarterly against staging and pre-prod, and weekly agent-based checks for infra. Our internal SLA for critical (CVSS 9-10) is 72 hours to mitigation or documented mitigation plan.

Attachments included: meditech-pen-summarized-redacted.pdf, meditech-vendor-questionnaire.xlsx (our standard security intake).

We will need an NDA to share the full SOC 2 and the detailed pen report. I created a short vendor-nda template we can send via DocuSign — I can forward as soon as you confirm. Also — does Redwood require any specific scope for pen tests (e.g., box blackbox vs. authenticated assessment, testing on canary/staging IP ranges)? We usually need scope defined before sharing more detail.

Cc'd security@meditech.com (our security intake alias) so they can pick up the follow-up.

Best,
Carmen Diaz
Head of Vendor Risk | Meditech Health Systems
carmen.diaz@meditech.com | +1 212-555-7814

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Carmen Diaz <carmen.diaz@meditech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call security recap: SOC2 / pen test & vulnerability process next steps

Carmen —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the redacted summary. A few clarifying notes and our standard asks to make the security review productive:

1) NDA: yes please — we’ll sign the DocuSign you send. For speed, Redwood usually uses a mutual NDA (I can also push Legal to accept your template).

2) Pen test scope: for our evaluation we request the full external report and, if available, the authenticated assessment results. If Meditech only has external blackbox results, the redacted summary you sent is a good start — we will likely request authenticated scan evidence during the tech review.

3) Vulnerability management SLA expectations (Redwood’s suggested alignment):
   - Critical (CVSS 9-10): initial triage within 4 hours, mitigation or documented workaround within 72 hours;
   - High (7-8.9): triage within 24 hours, fix within 14 days or documented compensating controls;
   - Medium/Lower: remediation cadence by risk and backlog with planned quarterly remediation sprints.

4) Scanning cadence suggestion:
   - External unauthenticated scans: monthly (Meditech current practice aligns).
   - Authenticated scans: at least quarterly against staging/pre-prod prior to major releases.
   - Weekly vulnerability agent checks for infra where feasible.

5) Disclosure policy: Redwood asks for at least a 30-day coordinated disclosure window for critical vulnerabilities that affect both parties' customers, with a joint comms plan. If Meditech has a different SLA we can negotiate details in the MAP.

6) Deliverables from Meditech to unblock our security review:
   - Signed NDA (DocuSign link) to receive full SOC 2 and pen test reports.
   - Completed vendor questionnaire (the Excel you attached is fine) — Marissa will intake that and coordinate technical questions.
   - Any remediation evidence for prior critical findings that are relevant to public-facing endpoints.

Next steps:
- Carmen, if you send the DocuSign NDA I’ll get it routed immediately.
- Marissa will intake the questionnaire and may ping for a few technical clarifications; Diego will be available to join a follow-up call for infra-specific questions.
- Proposed follow-up call window: week of Dec 6 — I’ll send a calendar invite for 30 minutes once NDA is signed.

Attachments: redwood-security-checklist.pdf (again).

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
